=== ArrowLeft at the content start jumps to the end of the item above
--- given
- abc
- ‸d
--- when key ArrowLeft
--- then
- abc‸
- d

=== ArrowLeft above a folded item lands on the folded line, not inside it
--- given
- a ⊟
  - b
- ‸c
--- when key ArrowLeft
--- then
- a‸ ⊟
  - b
- c

=== ArrowLeft at the start of a notes line goes to the end of the line above
--- given
- a
  ‸note
--- when key ArrowLeft
--- then
- a‸
  note

=== ArrowLeft away from the content start passes to the editor
--- given
- a‸b
--- when key ArrowLeft
--- then passthrough
- a‸b

=== ArrowLeft on the first item swallows the key
--- given
- ‸a
--- when key ArrowLeft
--- then consumed
- ‸a

=== ArrowLeft after the bullet only jumps from before the box
--- given stick=bullet-only
- a
- ‸[ ] b
--- when key ArrowLeft
--- then
- a‸
- [ ] b

=== ArrowLeft lands after the previous item's notes line
--- given
- a
  note
- ‸b
--- when key ArrowLeft
--- then
- a
  note‸
- b

=== ArrowLeft passes to the editor when the cursor is not kept in the content
--- given stick=never
- a
- ‸b
--- when key ArrowLeft
--- then passthrough
- a
- ‸b
